info.title: Lykia API
info.summary: Agents and stablecoins on Arc Network through one API, from a one-line quote to enterprise payouts.
info.description:
Built on Arc Network and Circle's rails. Plan money moves in plain words, check them against a Fence, hand unsigned steps to the user's wallet and follow them to finality. The server never signs.

Authenticate with `Lykia-Key` (lk_live_… or lk_test_…; test keys only reach testnet) or a `Lykia-Session` from wallet sign-in. Pin behaviour with `Lykia-Version` (2026-06-01, 2026-11-01). Send `Idempotency-Key` on POSTs. Every answer carries `X-Request-Id`; every error is `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

post.summary: Goal language -> lykia.program/v1 -> plan for now + drafts for later
post.description: The intent compiler. Reads several goals, time (every month, if BTC goes above) and abstract wording (safe, the rest, a third, out within a day) into a typed, hashed program; resolves shares, remainders and reserves against the owner's balances (or what-if balances); compiles one plan for now (route-searched under the Fence, the program digest pinned in the Fence facts) plus automation, order, alert and standing-order drafts with links to their prefilled forms; and explains assumptions, trade-offs, rejected alternatives and what is deferred. overrides change an assumption by id. Nothing is signed or saved; plan: true stores the plan for signing.

LykiaKey.name: Lykia-Key
LykiaKey.description: API key. Scopes: read (Every GET: networks, venues, the Flock, Scent, intents, logs and usage.); quote (Quotes and checks that move nothing: route search, quotes, Fence evaluate and validate, sentence parsing.); build (Plans and unsigned transactions: create intents, prepare steps, Tag drafts, MCP.); execute (Record signed transactions and control running plans: submit, stop.); agents (The Pack and Lyko's agent: spawn, revoke, chat.); automation (Standing orders, limit orders, alerts and agent automations.); payouts (Business money movement: payouts, invoices and treasury flows.); admin (Account settings: keys, webhooks, projects, billing.); plan (Legacy: implies quote, build and execute.); webhooks (Legacy: manage webhook endpoints.)

LykiaSession.name: Lykia-Session
LykiaSession.description: Session token from POST /v1/auth/verify (SIWE on Arc).

X402.name: X-PAYMENT
X402.description: x402 payment (USDC on Arc) for paid routes and pay-as-you-go overage.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 8 to 128 characters. Retries with the same key and body replay the first answer (Idempotent-Replayed: true); a different body is 409.

LykiaVersion.name: Lykia-Version
LykiaVersion.description: API version date. Defaults to the key's pinned version, else 2026-11-01.

RequestId.description: Unique id of this request; quote it to support.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests per minute allowed for this key.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

LykiaVersion.description: The API version that served the request.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks a scope, the IP or origin is not allowed, or a test key asked for mainnet (LIVE_MODE_REQUIRED).

Conflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used with a different body, or the first request is still running.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED or QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Retry-After says when.

PaymentRequired.description: x402 payment required: { x402Version, error, accepts: [PaymentRequirements] }.

ServerError.description: An internal or upstream failure. Safe to retry GETs; retry POSTs with the same Idempotency-Key.
